deploy-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOMATED PAGER: hot rollout anomaly detected for release v2026-03 (artifact: weights-pack-7f3a). canary fleet failing health checks. anomaly detected: tokenization mismatch and garbled outputs. spike in 5xx generation errors (canary only)

oncall-alex: seeing it on the dashboard, +1. can we isolate canary and flip traffic?

sre-jen: confirmed. canary nodes returning high perplexity + tokenization errors. stack traces show tokenizer lookup KeyError for token id 5012. suspect vocab mismatch between weights-pack-7f3a and tokenizer-v1. runbooks suggest kill-flag then rollback.

ml-sam: we shipped a weights pack built against tokenizer-v2 but the release metadata referenced tokenizer-v1. bad artifact tag during packaging.

support-jordan: we've received 3 customer reports in the last 4m (two chatbots returning gibberish, one embed job failing). CS triage: medium priority, some timeouts.

pm-lina: opening incident bridge now, heading to notify affected accounts. please include estimated RPS impacted.

incident-bot: Incident created: #bridge-5051 | Sev: high | Pager duty: oncall-alex | Runbook: weights-tokenizer-mismatch

oncall-alex: proceeding to flip feature flag to stop the new weights rollout. executing: `redwoodctl feature-flag set serve-v2026 off --scope=canary`

sre-jen: running kill-switch command now: `curl -XPOST https://ops.redwood/api/flags/serve-v2026/disable -H 'Auth: token'` -> 200 OK. verifying traffic routing...

ml-sam: checking canary logs post-flag: tokenization errors drop to baseline within 30s. KV cache warmup still in progress but outputs look sane again.

support-jordan: update to CS: we told customers we detected a rollout issue and we rolled back canary. we're tracking and will update in 30m.

pm-lina: trigger rollback of weights-pack-7f3a to previous stable artifact weights-pack-6e2b. `deploy-bot rollback --artifact=weights-pack-6e2b --target=canary`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated, canary redeploy to weights-pack-6e2b. ETA ~4m per node.

sre-jen: monitoring metrics: error rate trending down, latency stable. starting post-mortem notes (brief) so we can capture root cause. please drop any repro logs here.

ml-sam: root cause summary draft: packaging pipeline did not validate tokenizer version compatibility; manifest metadata override allowed ambiguous tokenizer pointer. will add a CI validation and a pre-flight check.

support-jordan: final customer impact estimate for initial window: ~0.25% of global requests routed to canary experienced garbled output; 3 paying customers reported issues, no data exfiltration. CS recommends 2 credits for affected tenants.

oncall-alex: handing off to on-call follow-up team: @sre-jen please take long-running actions. I'm staying on for 15m.

incident-bot: Pager cleared for oncall-alex. Bridge archived pending postmortem.

sre-jen: taking it on. next steps: confirm packaging fix, push CI gate, run a small canary re-release with explicit tokenizer-v2 artifact and run token-level diff tests.

ml-sam: will create a patch branch to pin tokenizer in packaging and add preflight `token-id` sanity check. ETA for PR: 2h.

pm-lina: I'll prepare a customer-facing blurb for tomorrow's status page. good job triaging quickly. :thumbsup:

support-jordan: note added: customer impact, credits suggested, CS follow-up scheduled.

sre-jen: logging complete. closing this thread after postmortem created.

deploy-bot: Event log: 5051236789 - hotroll anomaly -> 5051236890 flag disable -> 5051236920 rollback start -> 5051237005 rollback complete -> 5051237045 metrics stabilized
